tool.name: Biomni: Find N Glycosylation Motifs
tool.description: Scan a protein sequence for N-linked glycosylation sequons (N-X-[S/T]).
tool.help:
**Biomni: Find N Glycosylation Motifs**
Scan a protein sequence for N-linked glycosylation sequons (N-X-[S/T]).
Rules - Motif: Asn (N) followed by any residue except Proline (P), followed by Serine (S) or Threonine (T) - By default, overlapping matches are not reported twice
Parameters - sequence: protein sequence (one-letter amino-acid codes) - allow_overlap: if True, allow overlapping motif detection
Returns - Research log string summarizing motif locations and counts
**Domain**: glycoengineering **Function**: find_n_glycosylation_motifs
